blocks.text: By the end of this chapter, students will be able to:

items: grasp the interdisciplinary nature of data science, understanding various data types, collection methods, and storage techniques. They will also demonstrate proficiency in data science, machine learning, and data visualization, effectively applying these skills to address real-world business challenges and communicating findings through advanced data visuals.

blocks.text: In this chapter, students will learn the fundamentals of data and analysis and their importance in modern computing. They will explore the basics of data science and understand different types of data, including structured and unstructured data, along with methods of data collection and storage. The chapter introduces machine learning as a way for systems to learn from data and make decisions. The chapter explains how to evaluate model performance using measures like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and how to improve models through validation and tuning. Finally, the students will be introduced to common tools such as Excel, R, and Python used in data science and machine learning.
